svg.text: PJSOFONIC ERP — Complete System Architecture & Working Flowchart
Multi-Role Lifecycle: Admin • Team Leader • Full Stack Developer • Quality QA & QMS • Final Completion

g.text: 1. EMS AUTHENTICATION GATEWAY & DYNAMIC ROLE INGESTION
• Auth with Employee ID / Email + Password
• Fetches real-time profile from EMS Backend
2. STAGE 1: CRM INGESTION & ADMIN ASSIGNMENT TO TEAM LEADER
• Dropdown strictly lists registered EMS Team Leaders
• Format: [TL ID] Full Name - Department Scope
• TL: '[Admin Name] assigned project to you'
3. STAGE 2: TEAM LEADER EXECUTION & 4 FULL STACK DELIVERABLES
• Dispatches directly to Quality Queue & QMS
4. STAGE 3: QUALITY ASSURANCE & LIVE QMS TESTING PLATFORM
• Saves & syncs directly to ERP database
• Moves project to Team Leader Quality section
• Posts test results back to ERP via POST /test-results
5. STAGE 4: TL 'ALL DONE' SUBMISSION & ADMIN FINAL TOTAL APPROVAL
• Routes to Admin for final sign-off
• Project marked COMPLETED across all profiles
• Live broadcast notification to all users
